caption: The drawing depicts an enclosure made of vertical metal bars, forming a three-sided fence with a gate in the center section. The enclosure is drawn in perspective, showing two side panels converging to the back. Each vertical bar is topped with a decorative, fan-shaped motif, and the upper corners of the fencing feature additional ornamental scrollwork. The gate section in the middle is distinguished by an arched top that contains intricate, radiating fan designs, and is surmounted by a cross at its highest point, with scroll details on either side beneath the cross. The lower section of the fencing features a repeating geometric pattern resembling a Greek key design. The entire composition is rendered in monochrome shades of gray and black, using fine lines and shading to suggest metal material and intricate craftsmanship. The background is plain and unadorned, and the structure stands on a lightly shaded geometric base, giving a sense of depth.
title: Iron Gate and Fence
